title: What If a Light-Speed Needle Hit Earth?
description: If a microscopic needle struck Earth at the speed of light, the kinetic energy unleashed would vaporize continents instantly. Drop your thoughts in the comments on what other cosmic objects we should test next! #Shorts #ExtremeScience #Physics #Space

scenes.speaker: host
scenes.narration: What happens if a simple sewing needle hits Earth moving at ninety-nine point nine percent the speed of light?
